Bridge Closed in Chesterfield
                                
                                 Apr 15, 2026
                                 The Kelly Toponce bridge that crosses the Portneuf River, East of the Nipper Road and West of the Boundary Road is closed indefinitely.  The Bridge has been condemned at this time.  There is no reopening date.
